page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6r.xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the arm64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs using the Ampere Altra processor running at 2.8 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes no local storage, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals average performance across several core compute metrics. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1789.99, and the multi-core score is 7136.84, both falling into the average category. Large block memory bandwidth is average, with read speeds at 50.64 GB/sec and write speeds at 29.82 GB/sec. However, the instance exhibits weak performance in single-core small block memory bandwidth at 283.98 GB/sec and single-threaded gzip compression at 23.76 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and memory scores are also weak, and the CPU encryption test registers a poor score of 649.99.

The ecs.g6r.xlarge offers a balanced resource density for arm64-native workloads, presenting a cost-efficient profile for applications optimized for ARM architecture. However, the lack of local storage and weak performance in cryptographic operations and compression tasks represent notable tradeoffs. It is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and lightweight language model text generation, where it achieves an average speed of 104.82 tokens per second for a small 135M model.
